pairs.poly_rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's December 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

This market will resolve based on which show this update ranks as the #1 global Netflix show. If multiple shows tie for #1, this market will resolve according to the show whose listed title comes first alphabetically.

The ranking is based on total views globally, as reported by Netflix for TV shows (English only).

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by November 20, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

pairs.kalshi_rules: If any performer sings Big Pimpin' at the 2027 Super Bowl, then the market resolves to Yes.
pairs.poly_text: Will "Big Pimpin'" be played at the 2027 Big Game halftime show?
pairs.poly_rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed song is played by any performer during the Super Bowl LXI halftime show currently scheduled for February 14, 2027. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

To qualify as "played" a performer must sing at least some of the lyrics of a specified song during this event.

If this event is cancelled or otherwise delayed beyond March 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be footage of the Super Bowl LXI halftime show, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

pairs.kalshi_text: NHL Metropolitan Division Winner Philadelphia Flyers
pairs.kalshi_rules: If the Philadelphia Flyers win the 2026-27 NHL Metropolitan Division, then the market resolves to Yes.
pairs.poly_text: Will the Philadelphia Flyers win the 2026-27 NHL Metropolitan Division?
pairs.poly_rules:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the Metropolitan Division in the 2026-27 NHL regular season, as determined by the final official NHL standings, including any official NHL tiebreakers.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the Metropolitan Division (e.g. mathematical elimination before the end of the regular season), the associated market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NHL regular season is cancelled, or has not been completed by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NHL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
